settings.label: DexPaprika API key
settings.help: Your own free key from dexpaprika.com. Without one the service runs on the keyless tier (10,000 credits per 30 days per IP) and ingests far fewer new tokens.

settings.label: DexPaprika plan
settings.help: Free keys use api.dexpaprika.com; paid keys use api-pro.

settings.help: Your own key from dev.blockscout.com (PRO API). It adds holder concentration and the deployer on Robinhood Chain (free plan) and Base (Builder plan or above); without it those checks read not_available.
